title: VP Sales, EMEA
description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why This Role?

As our VP Sales, EMEA you will spearhead year-over-year revenue growth by developing and executing on enterprise level customer acquisition strategies across the region. You will drive long-term success through strategic development, coaching, and expanding Cohere’s presence in EMEA. In this pivotal leadership role, you will cultivate and guide our enterprise sales team to exceed revenue targets and organizational goals, while fostering a culture of excellence and innovation.

Candidates must be based in Germany to be considered for this career opportunity.

As our VP Sales, EMEA you will:

- Develop, execute, and lead a comprehensive go-to-market growth strategy and strategic sales plan for EMEA, driving revenue growth and market expansion.

- Provide strategic sales and operational leadership to Cohere’s cross-functional teams, ensuring alignment with company objectives

- Serve as the primary representative of Cohere in EMEA, championing the company’s vision, products, and services.

- Partner with global Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams to synchronize sales efforts with broader company goals.

- Represent Cohere at industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities, as well as with regulators and government agencies, in collaboration with the Head of Global Public Sector and Head of Government Affairs & Public Policy.

- Manage and nurture relationships with enterprise-level clients and partners to ensure Cohere’s success in the region. Identify and pursue new business opportunities, negotiating and closing high-value deals.

- Collaborate with global teams to strengthen anchor relationships and establish best practices for enterprise-level project implementations, ensuring strong client engagement throughout project lifecycles.

- Analyze and report on regional market trends, opportunities, client needs, and competitor activities to inform strategic decisions.

This career opportunity may be a good match for you if you:

- Are based in Germany.

- Have 15+ years of executive level experience leading go-to-market efforts and driving revenue growth for fast paced technology organizations.

- Possess a proven track record of leading enterprise-level consultative solution sales and business development efforts, with a deep understanding of regional GTM strategy, customer success, and resource allocation.

- Have exceptional communication and leadership skills, with the ability to build cross-functional relationships and influence at all levels.

- Are comfortable operating in a matrix environment, coordinating efforts across cross-functional teams and regions without the need for a large direct organization.

- Are a self-starter with an entrepreneurial mindset, capable of working independently, rolling up sleeves, and driving impact as a ‘builder.’

- Experience in AI or a related industry is highly desirable.

title: Head of Partner Programs, Strategy and Operations
description:
Apollo .io is the leading go-to-market solution for revenue teams, trusted by over 500,000 companies and millions of users globally, from rapidly growing startups to some of the world's largest enterprises. Founded in 2015, the company is one of the fastest growing companies in SaaS, raising approximately $250 million to date and valued at $1.6 billion. Apollo .io provides sales and marketing teams with easy access to verified contact data for over 210 million B2B contacts and 35 million companies worldwide, along with tools to engage and convert these contacts in one unified platform. By helping revenue professionals find the most accurate contact information and automating the outreach process, Apollo .io turns prospects into customers. Apollo raised a series D in 2023 and is backed by top-tier investors, including Sequoia Capital, Bain Capital Ventures, and more, and counts the former President and COO of Hubspot, JD Sherman, among its board members.

As the Head of Partner Operations, you will build and own the operating system that allows Apollo 's Partnerships business to scale. Sitting within Revenue Operations, you will be the connective tissue between partner strategy and the company-wide systems, data, processes, and commercial infrastructure that make partner motions work.
This is a high-leverage role at the intersection of Partnerships, Revenue Operations, Systems, Data, Finance, Legal. Partner Managers own relationships and execution; you own the operational infrastructure underneath them and you’ll help co-author our partner strategy. You'll establish the metrics and reporting that leadership uses to understand partner performance, architect the processes and systems that support different partner motions, and ensure the commercial mechanics behind those motions work reliably.
You'll operate across Apollo 's technology, agency, integration, and strategic partner ecosystem. The goal isn't simply to make today's processes run better. It's to build a scalable Partner Operations function that can absorb new partner motions, eliminate operational friction, and give the business a clear understanding of where partnerships are creating revenue and where the model needs to evolve.
The Opportunity
This is an opportunity to build a function, not inherit a playbook.
Partnerships is becoming an increasingly important part of Apollo 's revenue ecosystem, but partner motions create a unique operational challenge: the work crosses organizational boundaries, the data often lives across multiple systems, and the right operating model changes as the business learns.
The Head of Partner Operations will be responsible for turning that complexity into leverage. You'll help define how Apollo measures partner impact, how partner motions are structured, how systems support them, and how the company can scale partner revenue without scaling operational overhead at the same rate.
The strongest person in this role will leave the Partnerships organization with something substantially better than they found it: a clear operating model, trusted data, scalable systems, reliable commercial mechanics, and a set of partner motions that can evolve without rebuilding the infrastructure from scratch.
What You'll Do
Key Outcomes: Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:

• Build the operating system for Partnerships. Establish the processes, systems, data model, and governance that allow Partnerships to operate as a measurable, scalable revenue channel. Define clear ownership across Partner Managers, RevOps, Systems, Data, Finance, Legal, and other stakeholders, and create the operating cadence that keeps the machine running.

• Architect partner motions and commercial models. Partner with the VP of Partnerships and RevOps to design how different partner motions should work end-to-end, from acquisition and qualification through onboarding, activation, revenue generation, expansion, and renewal. title: Account Manager (m/f/d)
description:
YOUR JOB

Are you excited by the idea of growing existing customers instead of chasing cold prospects? Do you thrive when commercial ownership, strategic account development and closing responsibility come together? As one of the first Account Managers at DataGuard, you'll take ownership of a portfolio of customers with significant untapped growth potential and help build our Account Management function from the ground up. If you enjoy uncovering new opportunities, expanding customer relationships and turning business challenges into commercial success, we'd love to hear from you.

WE PROTECT THE PEOPLE BEHIND THE DATA

We are a fast-growing security and compliance tech company with a clear purpose: we protect the people behind the data. With over 200 team members worldwide and with offices in Munich, Berlin, London, Stockholm, and Vienna, we help more than 4,000 global customers get certified fast and build a strong and scalable risk posture. With AI-powered automation, self-serve capabilities, and additional tailored expert advice, we offer our customers a seamless security and compliance experience to stay ahead of the rapidly evolving security landscape and challenges like the surge in cyber-attacks.

WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

- You take ownership of expansion revenue across a portfolio of existing customers that has been intentionally selected for its significant growth potential

- You help build DataGuard's Account Management function from the ground up, shaping processes, collaboration models and best practices along the way

- You create and execute strategic account plans that uncover new use cases, engage additional stakeholders and unlock growth opportunities across your accounts

- You turn customer needs, regulatory changes and compliance & security requirements into commercially meaningful conversations and expansion opportunities

- You work closely with Customer Success and Professional Services, leveraging their customer insights to identify and convert opportunities into revenue

- You build trusted relationships with key stakeholders and lead commercial discussions from discovery through to negotiation and close

- You drive long term account growth while helping more customers benefit from the full breadth of DataGuard's Security and Compliance solutions

- You collaborate closely with the wider Sales team and report directly to the Head of Sales, playing a key role in DataGuard's growth journey

WHAT YOU'LL GET IN RETURN

- The freedom, trust, and tools to do what you love and make an impact in a purpose-driven company, committed to doing genuine good in the digital world.

- Enjoy a high degree of flexibility with tailored working hours, choice of work location, and benefits that support your lifestyle, health, and family needs.

- Join a secure, future-focused role in a dynamic scale-up positioned to make a major impact in the rapidly expanding Security & Compliance market.

- Grow along expert or leadership paths with support from employee accelerator programs, bi-annual feedback cycles, and a personal training budget.

- Work in an environment that values autonomy, rapid decision-making, a flat hierarchy, and collaborative, eye-level communication to keep things moving forward

THE QUALITIES YOU'LL NEED FOR A SUCCESSFUL CAREER AT DATAGUARD

- You have experience owning revenue targets across a portfolio of existing customers, named accounts or a book of business in a B2B SaaS Environment

- You know how to spot opportunity where others see a satisfied customer

- You consistently uncover and convert growth opportunities into revenue through upsell, cross sell and strategic account development

- You know how to navigate multiple stakeholders and build business cases that lead to commercial outcomes

- You thrive in environments where not everything is fully built yet and see ambiguity as an opportunity rather than a blocker

- You are fluent in German and English

LAST BUT NOT LEAST. FROM THE BOTTOM OF OU

title: Sr. Principal Mechanical Integration Engineer – Data Center Liquid Cooling
description:
At Jabil (NYSE: JBL), we are proud to be a trusted partner for the world's top brands, offering comprehensive engineering, supply chain, and manufacturing solutions. With 60 years of experience across industries and a vast network of over 100 sites worldwide, Jabil combines global reach with local expertise to deliver both scalable and customized solutions. Our commitment extends beyond business success as we strive to build sustainable processes that minimize environmental impact and foster vibrant and diverse communities around the globe. How will you make an impact?
The Senior Principal Mechanical Integration Engineer will have a critical understanding of manufacturing processes for thermal components and solid comprehension of thermal design and analysis to lead and oversee the mechanical systems essential for Data Center Infrastructure functionality. This role will involve developing specifications, selecting key components, component placement, selecting fastening methods, and transitioning design to manufacturing. Additionally, the position includes leading test process implementation and equipment selection to maintain the highest standards of operational excellence and reliability.
Job Title : Senior Principal Mechanical Design Engineer
Organization : Data Center Infrastructure Team
Location : Remote* OR Austin, TX
*Requires up to 30% domestic and/or international travel (rare)
What will you do?

• Have a strong background in liquid cooling technology used in data center design and buildout.

• Act as the subject matter expert on all matters related to single phase and two-phase liquid cooling applications within hyperscale data centers, including primary and in-rack cooling solutions.

• Have expertise in both enclosed and facility-based cooling systems

• Have experience with current Cooling Distribution Unit (CDU) technologies

• Ability to detail operational expectations for LC Racks, Manifolds and other LC infrastructure (Pressure Ratings, Temperature Ranges (in/outlet), Flow Uniformity and Durability)

• Proficiency with testing concepts for leaks/mitigation and hydrostatic pressure validation, flow resistance analysis, and corrosion assessments to comply with international standards such as ASME and ISO.

• Knowledgeable on High-Density Liquid Cooling (HDLC) products utilized in global data center applications

• In depth knowledge of rack manifold manufacturing, design and function (Machining and Welding, Surface Finishing, Material and Surface Treatments, Post-Production Cleaning, Flow Optimization, Thermal Expansion, Connection Interfaces, High-Point Vents and Low-Point Drains)

• Review CAD/Technical Data Packages to determine and validate mechanical design requirements for components and their functions within a system environment

• Responsible for understanding product specifications, plumbing, and hydronic systems to lead reviews with all disciplines ensuring the design and components meet performance and applicable code requirements

• Ability to evaluate thermal data collected from engineering or manufacturing tests to confirm product conformance to thermo-mechanical requirements, testing and modeling

• Knowledgeable in fabrication practices and installation of copper, stainless steel and aluminum piping for large-scale cooling systems

• Understanding and conducting stress and flow analysis to ensure that the piping systems can withstand operational conditions without failure

• Collaborate with project managers on design quotations

• Provide technical input to identify and mitigate project risks that may impact project plans and schedules

• Conduct component selection for pipes, fittings, and valves based on factors like fluid type, temperature, pressure, and corrosion resistance in chillers, HVAC systems and liquid cooling loops

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and ensure system compatibility and integration for liquid cooling systems at the rack, site, equipment, and system

title: Senior AI Product Engineer, Fullstack
description:
About Arize

AI is rapidly transforming the world. As generative AI reshapes industries, teams need powerful ways to monitor, troubleshoot, and optimize their AI systems. That’s where we come in. Arize AI is the leading AI & Agent Engineering observability and evaluation platform , empowering AI engineers to ship high-performing, reliable agents and applications. From first prototype to production scale, Arize AX unifies build, test, and run in a single workspace-so teams can ship faster with confidence.

We’re a Series C company backed by top-tier investors,with over $135M in funding and a rapidly growing customer base of 150+ leading enterprises and Fortune 500 companies. Customers like , Uber, Siemens, and PepsiCo leverage Arize to deliver AI that works.

The Opportunity
AI is rapidly transforming the world. Whether it’s developing the next generation of human-level intelligence, enhancing voice assistants, or enabling researchers to analyze genetic markers at scale, AI is increasingly integrated into various aspects of our daily lives.
Arize AI is the leading AI observability and evaluation platform, empowering AI engineers to build and deploy high-performing, reliable models. As the AI landscape shifts from traditional ML to generative AI and agentic systems, Arize ensures teams have the tools to monitor, troubleshoot, and improve AI in production.
The Team
Our Fullstack Engineering team builds both the highly scalable distributed services that power Arize's ML observability platform and the intuitive frontend applications that bring these capabilities to life. The team primarily works in TypeScript and Python to create seamless data visualization and monitoring experiences, with some services written in Go. We focus on delivering robust features that help clients interpret, visualize, and monitor their AI and ML models across the entire stack.
You will be a part of the core team that drives product innovation at Arize. You will be challenged with understanding how some of the most impactful engineering teams are developing AI and LLM-powered applications, and how to build the right tools to enable them to do their best work. Our product solutions range from clean APIs that magically instrument applications, interactive playgrounds for prompt engineering and agent development, or scaling up real-time evaluation infrastructure to handle millions of annotations per second
What You’ll Do

• Write maintainable, scalable, and performant code across the stack primarily in Typescript and React with opportunities to work in Python and Go.

• Design and build APIs, and domain / object models specific to our customers’ Machine Learning and LLM workflows.

• Design and build out performant and reusable react components that will be used throughout the application.

• Research and implement cutting-edge visualization & dimensionality reduction algorithms in a distributed environment.

• Collaborate with our product, design, and directly with customer engineering teams to enhance and expand our product offerings.

• Contribute to the build our own in-house AI Agents

• Participate in or lead architectural decisions for new and existing features in collaboration with product, design and our backend teams.

• Contribute to design & code reviews and technical documentation.

What We’re Looking For

• 5+ years of frontend experience working on external user-facing UI’s - preferably in React and Typescript

• Previous experience debugging complex systems in a team environment.

• Enthusiasm and interest in the AI and LLM ecosystem, with a desire to learn and stay updated on emerging technologies.

• Previous work building and operating highly complex, high-volume SaaS platforms/systems.

• Strong sense of product ownership in order to push features over the line.

• Passion for creating beautiful UX design with the end user in mind.

• A good teammate, someone who sees supporting their team as a core part of the job

title: Chief Product & Technology Officer
description:
About Nira Energy

• Nira's mission is to help convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free.

• We are profitable!

• Nira is a software platform that helps renewable energy developers find the cheapest points on the grid to connect.

• We focus on estimating the cost to interconnect with the electrical grid (aka the Interconnection Process). Depending on where developers connect, they may be on the hook to pay millions of dollars to upgrade power lines, substations etc.

About The Company

• Our mission is to convert the US power grid to be 100% fossil-free and do our part in combating climate change

• The electric grid is one of the largest bottlenecks standing between us and a clean energy future. Our software helps transmission engineers plan the grid in a faster, more economic, and more reliable manner

• We are the market leader in tranmission software and are currently used by >100 of the most sophisticated engineering teams in the country

• We are on a path to 5x’ing our revenue as we continue to rapidly scale with both our existing customers and into new markets

• We’ve been profitable since inception and have a highly unique financial profile. We aren’t subject to the traditional VC funding cycles and are anticipating material liquidity events for equity owners in the company

• This is a once in a lifetime opportunity to join a company that is positioned to have a massive impact on climate change, coupled with extremely high financial upside for the leaders that help bring these products to market

About The Role

This role will sit parallel to our co-founder and Chief Transmission Officer, Andrew, who is one of the foremost transmission planners in the industry. Andrew will be responsible for high level product vision and will serve as our SME on where the industry is heading.

The CPTO will be responsible for turning that vision into a sequenced roadmap and leading the team responsible for building those products.

The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning, and our Product Managers will report to the CPTO. For context, the Transmission Planning team works hand in hand with the software engineering team to write the code needed to generate our data. The organization is currently ~17 people with 2 Product Managers, 7 Software Engineers, and 8 Transmission Planners.

Ultimately, the CPTO will be the founders technical operating partner, responsible for translating customer insights into products as we scale to $50M+ ARR.

The ideal candidate is an executive with a strong track record of building high performing teams and world class products. You’ve ideally held a prominent role at an early stage startup, i.e $50M in revenue and can speak to successful product outcomes you’ve led there as well.

What you'll own

• Delivery and execution: You're the single point of accountability for how the product and engineering organization performs against its weekly, quarterly, and annual goals

• Product Decisions: You’ll partner with Andrew to set the product vision / roadmap direction and will ultimately be responsible for ensuring the team is making product decisions that increase revenue and retention

• People Leadership: The VP of Software Engineering, VP of Transmission Planning and the Product Managers will report to you. You’ll be responsible for managing their growth and performance and getting the organization to work as one smooth efficient machine.

• Operating Engine: You’ll be responsible for building the systems, processes and cadences to make product delivery predictable and efficient as we scale

What we're looking for

• A proven track record of building a high performing product team and executive leadership. You have led one or multiple product organizations and former reports regard you as a A+ leader that they’d join again in a heartbeat

• A proven track record of building successful products. You’ve led one or many product initiatives that have delivered material customer value

• Design, implement and improve remote server management capabilities (e.g., using standards like Redfish) and enhance Reliability, Availability, and Serviceability (RAS) features.

• Strong interest in CPU Architecture and Data Centre Hardware. Desire to dive deep in solving problems at the intersection of hardware and software.

• Hands on experience with hardware platforms, including design/requirements feedback, bring-up, system-level debugging, customer delivery, and support.

• Experience with most or all of: CPU architectures, BMC, BIOS, PCI-e, I2C (and SMBUS, PMBUS variants).

NICE TO HAVE REQUIREMENTS

•
Lead Through Change & Cross-Functional Alignment: Guide the team through evolving go-to-market motions with clarity. Partner with Sales, Renewals, Onboarding, and Product to unblock technical hurdles and advocate for customer needs internally.

Monitor & Report Performance: Track and report key metrics across retention, growth, adoption, and health scores to diagnose portfolio trends and optimize resource allocation.

The ideal candidate is an experienced people leader who thrives on operational discipline and is energized by complex, high-stakes customer relationships. You bring strong business acumen, sound judgment under pressure, and a genuine enthusiasm for the work-staying motivated and forward-looking through ambiguity and difficult stretches, and bringing your team with you.
Minimum qualifications:

•
Customer Success Experience: 6+ years in Customer Success or account management, with direct experience owning a strategic or enterprise book of business.

•
People Leadership: 1+ years of experience leading client-facing teams, with a track record of coaching, performance management, and developing high-tenured individual contributors serving matrixed enterprise clients.

•
Commercial & Operational Track Record: Proven success driving retention and growth targets, paired with strong business acumen across renewals, nego

If you are looking for a new opportunity to grow with a clinician founded and clinician led organization, look no further! As an authentic, unique, and skilled counselor, you have a plethora of options when it comes to work. Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. Unfortunately, the need often outpaces the services available to those we serve and only adds to the current mental health crisis in our nation. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. We are not interested in the “burnt-out” clinician that no longer finds meaning in their work and is just going through the motions; we are seeking people with a passion to provide excellent care, and the belief that we, together, can make a difference. If that’s you, then you’re in the right place!

Our approach with our team is simple, we take care of you, the clinician, so you can take care of patients. How do we do that? By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. The work we do with patients is hard enough and over the years we have found that our team often does their best work when the administrative burdens are taken off their plate and they are able to be fully present with their patients. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

Why bother with the endless administrative burdens and isolation of private practice? Use your highly trained interpersonal skills to change the culture around mental health care, decrease stigma, and help people who need you, while being supported by an experienced multi-disciplinary team of clinicians. Let us take care of the rest!

Want to work part time? No problem. Want to do group therapy? Sure! Want to do long-term psychodynamic psychotherapy with all of your clients? We do it every day. Interested in treating couples? We know you have exceptional skills; we want you to be part of our team.

The perfect candidate will share our passion for improving and expanding access to high quality mental health care and will thrive in a culture that emphasizes creativity, authenticity, humor, compassion, acceptance, and determination. Telehealth or onsite, we support your authentic and unique growth trajectory, while being yourself and having some fun!

• 401K with maximum employee matching.

• Full administrative support.

• Paid supervision, clinical rounds, and administrative time.

title: Associate Principal Electrical Engineer – Interconnection Studies
description:
Role Summary

Revamp is looking for an Associate Principal Electrical Engineer to lead interconnection and power systems studies for utility-scale solar and storage projects across the U.S. The studies you produce directly support the addition of renewable energy generation capacity to the north American power grid.

As an employee-owner on our growing team, you will be accountable for your assigned projects, scopes, budgets, and schedules, will serve as one of the discipline's main points of contact for clients and utilities, and mentor junior and mid-level engineers. Trust here is built through the quality of what you approve, and collaboration with our team of multidisciplinary stakeholders. This role may be performed remotely from almost anywhere in the US or Canada.

Salary range advertised above is in USD. In CAD, the range is $CAD 233,000 - 255,000.

Duties & Responsibilities

Core Technical & Functional Responsibilities

• Lead interconnection projects across ERCOT, PJM, CAISO, MISO, SPP, NYISO, and utility and cooperative systems.

• Guide clients from early plant sizing and application submission through scoping meetings, study reviews, mitigation discussions, and compliance closeout.

• Review ISO and utility study assumptions and results, identify issues, and direct responses or re-study requests.

• Lead large load interconnection modeling, assumptions, and study sensitivities.

• Develop steady-state and dynamic interconnection models to ISO and utility requirements.

• Perform and oversee RMS and EMT studies using PSS®E, PSLF, and PSCAD.

• Work with vendor and user-defined (UDM) inverter models, including model tuning and validation.

• Lead grid-following (GFL) and grid-forming (GFM) inverter modeling.

• Create and oversee the preparation of reports and presentations describing studies performed, solutions developed, and value delivered.

• Oversee Temporary Overvoltage, Transient Overvoltage studies for MV collection and substation designs.

Project & Portfolio Execution

• Oversee and guide the technical and delivery performance of a portfolio, or suite, of projects.

• Review and finalize scopes, budgets, and schedules for assignments, and identify risks or deviations early.

• Collaborating with BD, prepare proposals for professional engineering services for projects and portfolios.

• Direct the staff necessary to complete assignments, including staff and mid-level engineers, and mentor them in technical practice.

• Plan, schedule, and coordinate documents and activities across multiple major projects or an entire portfolio.

Quality, Standards & Compliance

• Ensure alignment with applicable FERC Orders governing interconnection processes, relevant NERC reliability standards (including MOD, PRC, and FAC), and IEEE 1547 and IEEE 2800 as implemented by ISOs and utilities.

• Prepare and approve model validation and model quality test reports suitable for ISO and utility submittals and audits.

• Review interconnection packages, modeling files, and complete project documents for conformity and quality assurance.

• Apply sound engineering judgment and standard company procedures to deliver accurate, defensible technical work products.

Collaboration & Communication

• As needed, will act as a supervisor of less experienced staff members.

• Act as the discipline's main point of contact for clients, ISOs, and utilities across a portfolio of interconnection projects.

• Communicate study impacts, mitigation options, and schedule risk to the developer services and design teams.

• Present study results, technical recommendations, and trade-offs to clients and internal stakeholders.

Program, Strategy & Innovation

• Track interconnection reforms, tariff changes, and modeling requirement updates, and set the team's response to them.

• Develop new techniques, tools, or improved processes for interconnection modeling and study production.

• Represent Revamp in industry working groups and stakeholder meetings.

title: Head of Partnerships
description:
ABOUT STARBRIDGE

We're building the front door for how businesses partner with government in America.

Public agencies spend roughly a trillion dollars a year with private companies, and nearly all of it still moves through infrastructure that hasn't changed in decades. Starbridge is building the full operating system for that relationship: the data, the signals, the workflows, and the rails that let a company find a public buyer, win the work, and get paid.

We monitor 320,000+ public sector entities around the clock. 500+ customers have joined us since our launch in March. We've raised $50M from top investors including Craft and Michael Seibel of Y Combinator.

 

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're building the next layer of growth beyond direct sales: a partner ecosystem.

We've validated that there's real demand for it. Today, referrals from agencies already generate substantial ARR with no dedicated owner and no formal program. We believe there is a much bigger opportunity with different personas. Leadership is aligned and ready to invest in a person who owns this end-to-end, from proving out the size of the opportunity to building the program that scales it.

This is a build-from-zero role. There is no existing partnerships function, no partner ops, and no program infrastructure. You'll start by answering one question: how big is the real referral partner universe for Starbridge, and where is it? Then you'll build the function needed to capture it. Compensation includes a quota component, so this role is accountable to revenue as well as activity.

 

What You'll Do

Phase 1: Prove the partner universe (0 to 1)

The first few weeks are about finding the real universe, not building infrastructure prematurely. You will:

- Start inside the base: Mine the existing customer base, CRM data, call recordings, and sellers to identify which agencies, consultants, and firms are already showing up around our 500+ customers.

- Define the IPP: Build the Ideal Partner Profile from real, observed examples rather than firmographic guesses. Starbridge's partner universe is wider than traditional public-sector consultancies. It includes Clay/RevOps/GTM-engineering and outbound agencies that happen to serve GovTech and EdTech clients, investors, conference and event businesses that hold MDF budgets, independent operators and advisors in govcon/govtech/edtech, and media, data-sharing, and PR partners.

- Land the first anchor referral partners: Prioritize influence over size. The goal is strong, founder-level engagement with a handful of the right partners.

- Define and create incentives for our IPP: These can range from thought leadership and data content to networking and PR opportunities.

Phase 2: Build the program

Once the universe and the economics are proven, you'll build the infrastructure to scale it, including:

- Partner enablement, certification, and a partner directory/tiering structure.

- Partner activation: making it easy for partners to routinely refer strong pipeline.

- Seller activation: making it easy and incentivized for the Starbridge sales team to work with partners.

- A repeatable recruitment and onboarding motion across every IPP category, not only agencies.

- Reporting and forecasting for partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue.

What you bring:

- Proven 0→1 builder: A track record building a partnerships, channel, or alliances function from zero to one, beyond running an existing program.

- Quota-driven mindset: Comfortable being measured on partner-sourced pipeline and revenue, not only program activity.

- Strong at market mapping: Able to identify a non-obvious partner universe through research, customer/CRM data, and direct outreach rather than relying on existing lists or inbound.

- Founder-mode relationship skills: A genuine relationship-builder who can earn founder-level trust with a small agency or independent operator as easily as with a larger firm.

- Comfortable in office 5 days a week

title: Product Manager - Data Supply Health and Traffic
description:
We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. We’re dedicated to empowering this transformation by building the tools and experiences that thousands of developers use to create their own products. Plaid powers the tools millions of people rely on to live a healthier financial life. We work with thousands of companies like Venmo, SoFi, several of the Fortune 500, and many of the largest banks to make it easy for people to connect their financial accounts to the apps and services they want to use. Plaid’s network covers 12,000 financial institutions across the US, Canada, UK and Europe. Founded in 2013, the company is headquartered in San Francisco with offices in New York, Seattle, Washington D.C., Raleigh, London, and Amsterdam.

About the Team
Our Network Enablement and Access team works to unlock the potential of Plaid's network by broadening and deepening our connections with data partners. We build the capabilities that help data providers participate in the network, strengthen the quality and reliability of those connections, and enable great products and experiences for Plaid's customers.

Within Network Enablement and Access, the Data Supply Traffic and Health team owns how Plaid's requests flow to the data providers we depend on. We manage the load placed on each provider, the constraints that shape our access, and the fair allocation of capacity across Plaid's products and new initiatives. As paid access expands across the network, we also work to keep that traffic reliable, efficient, and cost-effective.

 

As the Product Manager for Data Supply Health and Traffic, you will establish and lead a new product area at the foundation of every Plaid product. You will define how Plaid allocates constrained provider capacity, scales traffic across products, and manages the economics of paid data access.

 

You will also optimize for data freshness, balancing timeliness with provider capacity and cost so Plaid's products can deliver better experiences to end users. You will own the strategy and roadmap, partner closely with engineering and data-provider teams, and turn technical, contractual, and commercial constraints into clear product priorities.

 

This is a highly analytical and cross-functional role for someone who enjoys creating structure where no established playbook exists. In your first year, you will build the operating framework for traffic allocation and fairness, develop a clear view of paid-access cost and efficiency, and establish the metrics Plaid uses to run and improve this area.

 

Responsibilities:

- Define and own Plaid's strategy and roadmap for data-supply traffic, health, and cost efficiency.

- Build and prioritize traffic-optimization initiatives, including opportunities created by evolving machine-learning models and strategic concessions negotiated with providers.

- Serve as the bridge between Plaid's data-provider relationship teams and internal product teams, translating provider constraints into internal priorities and product demand into clear asks of providers.

- Partner deeply with engineering and data teams to understand system behavior, evaluate technical trade-offs, and turn analysis into decisions.

- Establish and track the core traffic and cost metrics needed to operate the area, identify risks, and measure progress.

 

Qualifications:

- 8+ years of experience, including 5+ in product management or equivalent founder/operator roles.

- Analytical rigor: You are comfortable working directly with data, cost models, and operational metrics to make and defend complex decisions.

- Deep technical fluency: You can reason about large-scale systems, load management, API platforms, and machine-learning models and engage engineers as a close product partner.

- Platform & systems thinking mindset: You think in systems, and design for reuse and the long term.

title: Head of Applied Science
description:
Rohlik is the leading Central European e-grocer. More than a million customers shop with us across Rohlik.cz http://Rohlik.cz, Knuspr.de http://Knuspr.de, Kifli.hu http://Kifli.hu, Gurkerl.at http://Gurkerl.at, and Sezamo.ro http://Sezamo.ro, choosing from over 20,000 items delivered within hours in 15-minute windows.

Behind every order is a continuous stream of automated decisions: how much inventory to buy for each warehouse, how many pickers to schedule on Thursday morning, where in the warehouse a product should sit, and which van carries which bags. Our models make these choices every day across five countries. When a forecast is accurate, shelves stay full and waste is minimized. When a plan is right, warehouses run on exact labor needs and orders arrive precisely in the customer’s chosen window. Get it wrong, and it immediately translates into shrink, overtime, tied-up capital, and missed customer deliveries.

WHY THIS ROLE IS EXCITING

- Direct operational and business impact: Your team’s models directly drive availability, shrink, fulfillment costs, and working capital across all five markets.

- True ownership with zero friction: We operate automated production pipelines with no committee between your team and deployment-a solid backtest is all you need to ship.

- Unification of two core capabilities: You will bring Forecasting and Optimization into a single function, building an end-to-end decision-making ecosystem from the ground up.

- AI-first environment: Our engineers use AI coding agents (Devin, Claude Code) daily, and we expect you to push the boundaries of modern agentic workflows and tooling.

- Direct executive exposure: Reporting directly to the Group CTO, you will have the mandate and space to shape technical strategy and execution.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN AND DELIVER

- Business outcomes: Own the business results delivered by the forecasting and optimization portfolio, setting targets with cell leads and tracking financial and operational impact in production.

- Strategic roadmap & prioritization: Define which decisions to automate next across purchasing, fulfillment center planning, workforce scheduling, and commercial optimization (promotions, markdowns, demand shaping).

- Technical standards & architecture: Set the bar for problem framing, method selection, fast production MVPs, honest evaluation/backtesting against business metrics, and reliability monitoring.

- Function unification & leadership: Merge Forecasting and Optimization into one high-performing team; set hiring standards, develop ML engineers and applied scientists, and foster an AI-first way of working.

- Cross-functional partnership: Partner closely with cell leads, operations managers, product owners, and engineering leads to align on business metrics, baselines, and seamless system integration.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Track record of impact: 8+ years applying machine learning, forecasting, or operations research to real operational or commercial problems, with clear metrics demonstrating business results.

- Works backwards from outcomes: A proven habit of defining target metrics first, selecting the simplest effective method, shipping fast MVPs, and iterating in production.

- Hands-on technical depth: Experience building and shipping production models in time-series/probabilistic forecasting or mathematical optimization (LP, MIP, CP, heuristics, simulation), with enough depth to review models and judge when simple heuristics beat complex models.

- Technical skills: Fluency in Python and SQL; hands-on experience with production pipelines, monitoring, and backtesting; familiarity with modern forecasting stacks or solvers (Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools).

- Operational fluency: Experience working directly alongside supply chain, warehouse, or logistics operations, including spending time on the floor to understand problems before framing models.

- Leadership & communication: Proven experience leading technical teams, hiring top talent

title: Sr Staff Technical Product Manager – Data Product Marketplace, Defense & Systems
description:
Job Description Summary
Operationalizes the Data Product Marketplace and enterprise catalog for Defense & Systems. The role manages, facilitates, and monitors the flow of data products from intake through to being consumable in the fabric: onboarding and certification intake, the catalog and discovery experience, self-service access workflows, and the adoption metrics that show whether any of it is working.
Standards come from the Principal Data Architect in the form of data-product contracts, schemas, and SLAs; policy comes from the Sr Principal Technical Product Manager. This role executes within both and owns the day-to-day consumer experience. Success improves Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost by shortening the path from a data product request to a governed, usable data product. Job Description
Why this role
The Data Fabric only matters if people use it, and that is what this role owns: the front door, the onboarding path, and the evidence of adoption. You will work directly with data product owners across Defense & Systems, run the intake process that moves products into the fabric, and hold the consumer experience to a standard. This is hands-on product management on a platform being built now, not caretaking of one already built.

Marketplace and catalog ownership

• Own the marketplace and catalog feature backlog: search and discovery experience, data-product previews, and self-service access workflows

• Prioritize and sequence the backlog against adoption impact and the enterprise roadmap set by the Sr Principal Technical Product Manager

• Maintain catalog completeness and data passport currency as products are published, enhanced, and deprecated
Data product onboarding and certification

• Manage data-product onboarding and certification intake, working the checklist and action plan alongside Data Product Owners

• Define product specifications with owners: SLAs, uptime targets, health scores, and critical data elements

• Partner with the Principal Data Architect to return certification and onboarding decisions within the defined SLA

• Confirm the design and integration pattern for each data product is agreed before integration work is planned and scheduled
Consumer experience and adoption

• Run user research and journey mapping with data consumers to find and remove adoption friction

• Track and report adoption and usage metrics: active users, adoption rate, time-to-access, and catalog completeness

• Report adoption results to the Sr Principal Technical Product Manager for value-realization reporting to the executive sponsor
Stakeholder engagement

• Manage data-product owners across multiple P&Ls without formal authority, using clear intake criteria and transparent prioritization

• Coordinate with federated Data Quality Analysts on specification validation and SLA fit by domain

• Brief P&L Data Stewards and Solution Architects ahead of process or standard changes
Required qualifications

• Bachelor's degree from an accredited university or college with a minimum of 5 years of professional experience OR Associate's degree with a minimum of 8 years of professional experience OR High School Diploma with a minimum of 10 years of professional experience.

• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in Data Product Management & Data Marketplace Operations or IT.

• Note: Military experience is equivalent to professional experience.
Eligibility requirement

• Legal authorization to work in the U.S. is required. GE Aerospace will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job.
Desired characteristics

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or Business (STEM or technical major preferred).

• Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) or SAFe Product Owner / Product Manager certification.

• Experience with data quality or data-product SLA and health-score frameworks.

• Working knowledge of data cataloging and self-service access tooling.

title: Social Media Coordinator
description:
Location:
Guardian Corporate Guardian Dentistry Partners is looking for a creative, highly organized, and hands-on Social Media Coordinator to elevate social media across our growing network of dental practices.

At Guardian Dentistry Partners , we support a network of 200+ thriving practices across 15.5 states (shoutout, D.C.!). We’re also proud to have been named in the Inc. 5000 list of America’s fastest-growing private companies for the fourth consecutive year, ranking No. 2,915 overall and No. 14 among dental companies nationwide.
Our culture is rooted in integrity, collaboration, and purpose, and we believe our success comes from the strength of our partnerships and the people behind them. We bring together passionate, purpose-driven dental entrepreneurs who share a commitment to exceptional care while celebrating the unique qualities that make each partner and practice special.

This role will be dedicated specifically to social media, with a focus on creating engaging, authentic content that brings our individual practices, teams, doctors, and Guardian Dentistry Partners brand to life.

This is not simply a content-scheduling position. We are looking for someone who is comfortable behind the camera, editing Reels and TikToks, identifying trends, coaching local teams, and developing content strategies that can scale across a large organization.

The Social Media Coordinator will manage our social presence while also helping our practices become stronger content creators themselves through training, resources, and ongoing support.

Key Responsibilities

Content Creation & Social Strategy

• Develop and execute social media content across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and emerging platforms

• Create engaging short-form video content, including Reels and TikToks

• Film, edit, and publish content featuring doctors, team members, patients when appropriate, office culture, education, technology, recruiting, and brand personality

• Identify relevant social trends and translate them into content appropriate for dental practices and the GDP brand

• Write engaging captions and social copy while maintaining individual practice brand voices

• Build content strategies that balance scalable national content with authentic, office-specific content

• Maintain social content calendars and ensure consistent posting across participating practices

• Monitor performance and use social analytics to continually improve content

Practice Support & Training

• Lead monthly virtual social media trainings and check-ins with participating practices

• Teach office teams how to capture better photos and videos and create engaging social content

• Develop simple content guides, prompts, shot lists, and best practices that make it easy for offices to participate

• Serve as the primary social media resource for practice teams

• Identify offices and team members who are strong content creators and help turn their ideas into scalable examples for the broader organization

On-Site Content Creation

• Travel to each of GDP's eight regions approximately once per year to capture original content

• Plan content shoots in advance to maximize the amount of usable content captured during each visit

• Capture a mix of practice-specific and evergreen content, including educational videos, technology, team culture, recruiting, doctor features, trends, and personality-driven content

• Organize and maintain a content library that can be repurposed across practices and platforms

Social Media Infrastructure

• Support the continued rollout and management of social accounts across GDP practices

• Ensure appropriate access, backup accounts, permissions, and account organization are maintained

• Help establish scalable processes as GDP continues to grow beyond 160 locations

• Partner with the broader marketing team to ensure social supports quarterly campaigns, brand initiatives, recruiting efforts, and practice-level priorities

title: Managed Care Financial Analytics Director
description:
Join the transformative team at City of Hope , where we're changing lives and making a real difference in the fight against cancer, diabetes, and other life-threatening illnesses. City of Hope ’s growing national system includes its Los Angeles campus, a network of clinical care locations across Southern California, a new cancer center in Orange County, California, and treatment facilities in Atlanta, Chicago and Phoenix. The Managed Care Financial Analytics Director leads the development of a dedicated analytics capability supporting payer negotiations, contract modeling, reimbursement strategy, payer performance management, and executive reporting across the enterprise. This is a highly strategic role responsible for transforming complex data into actionable insights that directly influence revenue performance, contract negotiations, and access to care. This leader partners closely across FP&A, IT/Data Governance, Revenue Cycle, Pharmacy, and Contract Administration to build scalable analytics solutions, guide value-based care strategy, and ensure City of Hope is reimbursed appropriately for its specialized care delivery.

As a successful candidate, you will:

• Build and lead a managed care analytics function, establishing scalable processes, standards, and operating models

• Develop financial models to support payer negotiations, renewals, and pricing strategies

• Produce negotiation-ready insights including reimbursement analysis, revenue impact, and margin sensitivity

• Translate payer strategy into data-driven decisions impacting contracts, service lines, and network strategy

• Analyze value-based care performance, bundled payments, and total cost of care models

• Partner cross-functionally to ensure data accuracy, governance, and actionable reporting

• Deliver executive-level dashboards and reporting to guide enterprise decision-making

• Support live negotiations with real-time modeling and financial scenarios

• Identify underperformance, denial trends, and contract compliance risks

• Drive improvements in payer strategy, reimbursement structures, and financial outcomes

Your qualifications should include:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, economics, healthcare administration, or a related field

• 10+ years of experience in healthcare or financial analytics, with managed care expertise

• 5+ years of leadership experience building and managing analytics functions or teams

title: Global Payroll Specialist
description:

Legora is redefining how legal work gets done. Not built for lawyers, built with them. We work alongside the world’s best legal teams, who expect excellence, precision, and speed, and we hold ourselves to the same bar.

Our AI-native workspace lets legal professionals move faster, think more clearly, and operate with sharper precision. By analysing thousands of documents in minutes and powering end-to-end workflows, we cut through complexity, teams can focus on what matters: judgment, strategy, and outcomes.

2,100+ customers across 80+ countries trust us, including Cleary Gottlieb, Goodwin, Linklaters, White & Case, Dentons, and Barclays. We’ve scaled to $200M+ in ARR, with teams across Europe, North America and APAC, and continue to expand through acquisitions including Qura, Walter AI, Graceview, Cadastral, and Wexler.

We partner with world-class performers: including Aaron Judge and the New York Yankees, Ludvig Åberg (and his caddie), and campaigns featuring Jude Law.

Joining Legora means three things.

- We lean in: ownership over titles, outcomes over intentions.

- We fight for excellence: high standards, direct, ego-free feedback.

- We grow together: as a team and with our customers.

Mission before ego. Everyone contributes. No one coasts.

If you’re driven by impact, pace, and raising the bar. This is the place.

THE ROLE

We’re hiring a Global Payroll Specialist to help build and scale payroll as Legora continues to grow internationally. Working closely with our Global Payroll Manager, you’ll help ensure payroll runs smoothly across multiple countries while also shaping the processes, controls, and ways of working that will support our continued expansion.

This is not a role where you’ll spend most of your time processing payroll yourself. Instead, you’ll coordinate with external payroll providers, review and quality-check their work, and help improve how we work as we enter new markets. As the function develops, there will also be room to shape parts of the role based on your strengths and interests.

 

WHAT YOU WILL BE DOING

- Coordinate monthly payroll cycles across multiple countries

- Act as a key contact for external payroll providers

- Make sure payroll is delivered accurately and on time

- Carry out validations, reconciliations, and checks before payroll is finalized

- Help ensure payroll follows local regulations and internal processes

- Support audits by keeping documentation clear and up to date

- Help build and improve payroll processes as we grow into new countries

- Create clear workflows and documentation so our ways of working can scale

- Work with payroll data from HiBob and ensure inputs are accurate and complete

- Partner closely with HR, Finance, and external vendors

- Step in as backup to the Global Payroll Manager when needed

WHO YOU ARE

What matters most is your mindset: you are curious, eager to keep learning, and excited by the opportunity to grow in a global payroll role. We are looking for someone who brings structure, ownership, and a willingness to figure things out in a fast-moving environment.

You also bring:

- 5+ years of payroll experience

- Strong understanding of payroll controls and processes

- Detail-oriented with strong analytical skills

- Comfortable working with HRIS and payroll systems

Legora is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Legora, we believe great teams are built on diversity of thought and experience. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and committed to creating an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work. We welcome people of all backgrounds and don’t discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

title: Prakitkant M&A Due Diligence (m/f/d)
description:
ÜBER BUENA

Buena wird von GV unterstützt und macht Immobilien einfacher: von der Wohnungssuche über den Kauf und die Finanzierung bis zur Verwaltung. Dafür kaufen wir Hausverwaltungen in ganz Deutschland und entwickeln sie mit eigener Technologie und besseren Prozessen weiter. Unser Ziel: Immobilieneigentum und Vermögensaufbau für mehr Menschen zugänglich machen.

ÜBER DIE ROLLE

Bevor wir eine Hausverwaltung übernehmen, müssen wir ihr Geschäft verstehen. Wie belastbar sind die Zahlen? Welche Risiken stecken in den Verträgen? Was braucht das Unternehmen, um nach der Übernahme erfolgreich weiterzulaufen?

Als Praktikant:in M&A Due Diligence gehst du diesen Fragen nach. Du arbeitest direkt mit dem Deal Lead und unserem Operations- und Deal-Team an laufenden Übernahmen. Dabei begleitest du Transaktionen vom ersten Datenraum über die Bewertung bis zur Entscheidung des Managements und zum Closing.

In unserem dreiköpfigen Team übernimmst du ab Tag eins eigene Workstreams und nimmst an Gesprächen mit den Geschäftsführern der Zielunternehmen teil. Deine Analysen fließen direkt in unsere Kaufentscheidung ein.

DEINE AUFGABEN

- Financial DD. Du analysierst BWAs, Jahresabschlüsse und Cashflows, prüfst Umsatz und verwaltete Einheiten und dokumentierst Red Flags. Du arbeitest an Kaufpreismodellen und rechnest Szenarien und Earn-out-Strukturen durch.

- Commercial & Operations DD. Du prüfst Objektlisten, Verwaltungsverträge und ERP-/Prozessdaten. Du bewertest Personal- und Kapazitätsbedarf und bereitest Fragen für die Gespräche mit der Geschäftsleitung vor.

- Entscheidungen vorbereiten. Du verdichtest deine Ergebnisse zu klaren Findings und Executive Summaries. Du bereitest Liegenschaftscontrolling und Liquiditätsplanung auf und lieferst Input für die Entscheidungsvorlage und die Anlagen zum Unternehmenskaufvertrag (SPA).

- Den DD-Prozess steuern. Du erstellst und pflegst Information Request Lists, organisierst den Datenraum in DataSite oder Google Drive und hältst fehlende Unterlagen nach. Du dokumentierst offene Fragen, Fortschritt und Ergebnisse in Linear.

- Eigene Workstreams verantworten. Je nach Erfahrung und Transaktion führst du einzelne DD-Workstreams von der ersten Datenanforderung bis zum Findings-Report.

DU PASST, WENN DU

- Bereits ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudententätigkeit in M&A, Transaction Services, Corporate Finance, Investment Banking, Private Equity, Wirtschaftsprüfung oder transaktionsnaher Beratung absolviert hast.

- BWL, VWL, Finance, Accounting, (Wirtschafts-)Recht, Wirtschaftsingenieurwesen oder etwas Vergleichbares studierst - ab dem fünften Semester oder im Master.

- GuV, BWA und Bilanz sicher lesen kannst und verstehst, was Umsatz, EBITDA, Working Capital und Verbindlichkeiten über ein Unternehmen aussagen.

- Bewertungsmethoden wie Multiples und DCF kennst und bereits angewendet hast.

- Excel sicher beherrschst: Pivot-Tabellen, XVERWEIS/SVERWEIS und das Aufbereiten und Konsolidieren unstrukturierter Daten.

- Sorgfältig arbeitest, Unstimmigkeiten hinterfragst und offene Punkte eigenständig klärst.

- Deutsch auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sprichst und schreibst. Gespräche mit Geschäftsführern, Verträge und Finanzunterlagen sind überwiegend deutsch.

- Für mindestens drei, idealerweise sechs Monate Vollzeit verfügbar bist und aus unserem Berliner Büro arbeiten möchtest.

WAS DU BEI UNS LERNST

- Wie wir als Käufer Unternehmen prüfen, bewerten und übernehmen - bei einer zweistelligen Anzahl an Transaktionen pro Jahr.

- Wie aus Finanzdaten, Verträgen und Management-Gesprächen eine belastbare Kaufentscheidung entsteht.

- Wie Bewertung, Kaufvertrag und spätere Integration zusammenhängen.

Bei guter Zusammenarbeit gibt es eine Perspektive für den Einstieg nach dem Praktikum.

DEINE BENEFITS

- Bis zu 500 € Close-to-Office-Bonus, wenn du innerhalb von 10-20 Gehminuten zum Büro wohnst oder dorthin ziehst.

- 110 € Lunch-Budget pro Monat und 50 € Fitness-Zuschuss.

- 1.200 € jährliches Weiterbildungsbudget

The Research Regulatory Coordinator Sr position is responsible for overseeing the regulatory aspects of clinical research studies taking place in UofL Health facilities and ULP clinics. The position communicates with the study team for each project and ensures regulatory requirements are met before the UofL Health Research Office (ULHRO) approval is granted. The position works closely with the UofL Health Clinical Research Review Committee (CRRC); the Interdisciplinary Research Oversight Council (IROC), the Research Regulatory Coordinator, the UofL Human Subjects Protection Program and External Institutional Review Boards (IRB). The Research Regulatory Coordinator Sr establishes standard operating procedures as needed to streamline operations and increase effectiveness and efficiency with the ULHRO team members and service line leaders. Position oversees processes to vet Research Personnel for access to EMRs and facilities. Position submits IRB applications for UofL Health employed staff and faculty to support Nursing Excellence initiatives and Pharmacy residency research.

Essential Functions:

• Develop processes and procedures as needed to streamline regulatory oversight in the UofL Health Facilities and ULP clinics

• Review all IRB correspondence, determine action items, and document content in ULHRO system to ensure appropriate next steps are completed.

• Review submissions to the ULHRO and establish the project records and documents as required for UofL Health Institutional Review.

• Facilitate the Clinical Research Review Committee (CRRC) process for clinical research based on the operational impact to patient care teams to ensure feasibility of projects.

• Train, assist, and oversee the Research Regulatory Coordinator as needed to ensure appropriate vetting for research personnel who need access to our EMRs & facilities.

• Ensure a valid HIPAA authorization exists for all research involving UofL Health patients’ data.

• Work closely with the Interdisciplinary Research Oversight Council to support the magnet journey and evidence-based practice by advising nursing staff on policies and procedures for research

• Prepare IRB submissions and maintain regulatory oversight for clinical research projects for UofL Health Nursing staff and Pharmacy residency as needed.

Other Functions:

• Review completed consent forms for accuracy and compliance.

• Review documents included in IRB submissions and IRB correspondence regarding collection and release of UofL Health medical records data. This includes reviewing protocols, waivers, consent documents and data collection sheets to determine if any changes are needed for HIPAA authorization to be congruent with protocol.

• Complies with HIPAA privacy and security requirements to maintain confidentiality at all times

• Performs other duties as assigned

Education:

Experience:

• 5 years of experience in research administration (preferred)

Venbrook Claims Services is seeking a dynamic and proven Vice President, Business Development to lead revenue growth strategy across Venbrook ’s full suite of claims management service offerings. This is a senior commercial leadership role responsible for driving new client acquisition, expanding existing relationships, and building a high-performing business development function aligned with Venbrook Claims’ national growth objectives. Reporting to the Head of Sales, the VP will serve as a key member of the claims leadership team, owning the end-to-end sales strategy and go-to-market execution across TPA services, complex claims management, independent adjusting, catastrophe services, and SIU.

The VP, Business Development will develop and execute a disciplined sales strategy targeting insurance carriers, MGAs, captives, brokers, self-insured entities, and public sector clients. This leader will build and manage a business development team, establish strategic partnerships, represent Venbrook Claims in the market, and collaborate closely with operations, marketing, and executive leadership to position the organization for sustained, scalable growth. The ideal candidate brings deep insurance industry relationships, a track record of closing complex, multi-service sales in the claims or TPA space, and the executive presence to represent Venbrook Claims at the highest levels.

POSITION REQUIREMENTS:

Sales Leadership & Revenue Ownership: Demonstrated ability to build and lead a business development function from strategy through execution. Proven track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets in a complex B2B services environment, with ownership of the full sales lifecycle from pipeline development through contract close.

Insurance Industry Expertise: Deep knowledge of the claims and TPA marketplace, including third party administration, complex claims management, independent adjusting, and specialty lines. Established relationships with decision-makers at insurance carriers, MGAs, captives, brokers, and self-insured organizations.

Strategic Market Development: Ability to identify, evaluate, and pursue new market opportunities across product lines, geographies, and client segments. Translates market intelligence and competitive dynamics into actionable sales strategy aligned with organizational priorities.

Client Relationship Management: Executive-level relationship development skills with the ability to cultivate and maintain long-term partnerships with C-suite and senior operational stakeholders. Skilled at navigating complex procurement processes and multi-stakeholder decision environments.

Team Building & Leadership: Experience recruiting, developing, and leading business development and sales teams. Provides coaching, direction, and accountability to team members while fostering a performance-driven, client-focused culture.

Communication & Executive Presence: Exceptional verbal and written communication skills with the ability to develop and present compelling proposals, RFP responses, and capability presentations to senior decision-makers. Represents Venbrook Claims with credibility and professionalism in all market-facing settings.

CRM & Pipeline Management: Advanced proficiency with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms. Skilled at building accurate pipeline forecasts, tracking team performance metrics, and delivering data-driven reporting to executive leadership.

Cross-Functional Collaboration: Ability to partner effectively with claims operations, finance, marketing, and technology teams to ensure seamless client onboarding, service delivery, and relationship continuity. Bridges commercial and operational functions to drive client satisfaction and retention.

title: Consumer Sales Strategy Manager
description:
At Lakeshore, every decision we make connects back to one thing: getting great learning materials into the hands of educators, families, and kids. As a Consumer Sales Strategy Manager on our Sales Operations team, you'll turn market signals, customer data, and competitive insights into clear recommendations that shape how we grow - and you'll work alongside teams across the company to help those recommendations actually land. If you like building with data, digging into the 'why' behind sales trends and translating what you find into action, this role was built for you.
A day on the job looks like this:

• Analyze customer behavior, sales performance, market trends, and competitive dynamics to develop insights and recommendations that sharpen our go-to-market approach.

• Support the development and execution of eProcurement sales initiatives by identifying opportunities to improve end-user engagement and align program activity with broader business goals.

• Build and maintain sales reports, dashboards, and presentation materials that give leadership a clear, current picture of performance and priorities.

• Partner with cross-functional teams - including Retail, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and others - to gather input, share findings, and keep key initiatives moving forward.

• Manage workstreams within larger strategic projects, tracking progress, flagging risks, and keeping stakeholders informed through organized, concise communication.

• Prepare executive-ready presentations and briefings, handling sensitive data and business information with care and discretion.

Got the skills and experience? Here’s what we’re looking for:
Required:

• 3-5 years of experience in sales strategy, analytics, consumer insights, or a closely related business role.

• Demonstrated ability to analyze complex data sets and translate findings into clear, actionable recommendations.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including experience preparing materials for senior audiences.

• Highly skilled with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, Outlook, SharePoint)

• Experience and comfort working with data sets and across multiple analytics tools and platforms

• Experience with eProcurement portals or B2B sales processes.

Preferred:

• Bachelor's degree in business, marketing, economics, math or a related field - or equivalent experience.

• Familiarity with customer segmentation methods or sales performance frameworks.

• Experience working in a retail, education, or consumer products environment.

What sets you apart:

• You make complexity simple - whether you're building a slide for the SVP or explaining a data trend to a cross-functional partner, your communication lands clearly the first time.

• You connect dots others miss, drawing links between customer signals, market shifts, and internal priorities to surface insights that actually move the needle.

• You stay organized without losing the big picture, managing multiple workstreams while keeping an eye on what matters most to the business.

And here’s our end of the bargain!
At Lakeshore, we pay local market wages for employees that reside within Los Angeles and Orange Counties. For employees residing outside of Los Angeles and Orange Counties, pay is based on national market.
For this position, new employees joining Lakeshore are typically brought into the organization at a salary rate between $61,500-$75,000 depending on relevant experience & skillset.
This range is indicative of projected hiring range. The annual base compensation will take into account each candidate's relevant experience, location, and skillset.

• Bonus eligible

• Paid leave for new parents to support work/life balance and family bonding

• Excellent medical/dental and vision coverage-EPO, PPO and HSA

• 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution (because you will retire someday)

• Flexible benefits-choose what you like, ignore the rest

• On-site preschool for our employees’ children

title: Associate, Sales
description:
The Associate role is a high-impact position designed for individuals looking to accelerate their career in legal sales. As an Associate, you will be responsible for driving the initial stages of the sales cycle, from outbound prospecting to closing trial accounts. This role serves as a critical talent pipeline, with a structured 12-24 month path toward promotion to Sales Director (SD).
What You'll Do

• Execute outbound prospecting strategies to identify and engage new legal firm leads - including cold calling and self-sourcing your own meetings.

• Manage and close inbound leads to maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

• Own a full-cycle, transactional sales process from first touch to close, aggressively following up on open pipeline to keep deals moving and get them across the finish line.

• Lead trial closing efforts, ensuring a seamless transition from initial interest to platform adoption.

• Consistently meet success KPIs, including call volume, transaction counts, and trial starts, to qualify for promotion.

Who You Are

• An extremely self-motivated hunter who takes ownership of their pipeline and doesn't wait to be handed opportunities.

• A proactive and highly organized professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment.

• A collaborative people person who builds strong internal and external rapport.

• Adaptable and capable of working effectively in a decentralized or physically remote setting.

• Ambitious and goal-oriented, with a clear desire to grow into a Sales Director (Account Executive) role.

What We're Looking For

• Prior experience in a fast-paced transactional sales organization, ideally as a top performing SDR/BDR, or SMB AE.

• Comfort and confidence picking up the phone - cold calling is core to this role, not a fallback.

• A true hunter mentality: someone who proactively books their own meetings rather than relying solely on inbound or marketing-sourced leads.

• Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to lead client meetings confidently.

• Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through.

• Collaborative mindset with experience working cross-functionally across sales and customer-facing teams.

Comp & Perks

• Competitive compensation package with uncapped incentive compensation.

• Full benefits: Medical, Dental, Vision, 401(k) with match.

• Clear career growth opportunity.

title: Hardware Systems Integration Engineer
description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril Expeditionary Systems (AES) is building AI Factories and Command/Control centers-specialized, high-performance computing centers designed to process petabyte-scale data and convert it into decisions at machine speed from forward operating bases. These are not traditional data centers. They are air-transportable, power-constrained, hardened systems optimized for AI inference at the tactical edge and deeply integrated with Lattice.

We are seeking highly experienced Lead Electrical Architects to play a pivotal role in defining and shaping the electrical architecture for our product lines. These roles will bridge the critical gap between high-level systems concepts and detailed electrical design, ensuring robust, scalable, and manufacturable solutions for our advanced defense systems. You will be instrumental in translating strategic Concepts of Operations (CONOPS) into actionable electrical requirements and architecture that will guide the entire product development lifecycle.

Exact candidate title and leveling to be determined based upon technical acumen, professional experience, leadership ability, and assessed capabilities through the interview process.
